context: Feedback supplied while v27 was open. This is a qualitative assessment of the shown work, not exact ratings assigned to every shot or automatic ratings of later drafts.
reason: Weak visual storytelling with too many overlapping images and text.
rubricStatus: Proposed editorial rubric; not a validated automatic quality metric or human-approved scoring system.

criteria.label: Clear action that advances the story
Consistent character, space and physical relationships
Movement and transitions serving the music

evidenceRule: Each rating requires the exact version, shot interval, inspected frames or playback, observed result, and reviewer. Still images cannot prove motion or audio alignment. Missing review remains unmeasured.
hardFailures: Essential content is obscured by unintended overlap
The action or its consequence cannot be understood
Essential text cannot be read at the target size
A static composition is relabeled as a new scene without meaningful visible change
threshold: Keep the existing foundation gate: required means above90, every item at least80, complete evidence and no hard failures. Beat timing is separate and cannot compensate for visual failure.
